decomposed_tasks.title: Fix Web Name
decomposed_tasks.description: Change the displayed web name / logo to 'Listen Audio' in layout and page.

decomposed_tasks.title: Specific Timestamp Input
decomposed_tasks.description: Add an input field to the player UI allowing users to manually enter a timestamp to seek to (e.g., HH:MM:SS) and jump directly there.

decomposed_tasks.title: Optimize History Saving Logic
decomposed_tasks.description: Change the auto-sync behavior to save the playback position only when the user pauses the audio, stops playing, or before unmounting, rather than every 5-6 seconds continuously. This prevents DB overload.

decomposed_tasks.title: Add Playback History UI
decomposed_tasks.description: Add a new UI section/modal on the main page displaying a list of previously watched audio URLs and their last saved timestamps, enabling users to jump back easily.

decomposed_tasks.title: Delete Individual History Record
decomposed_tasks.description: Add a delete button next to each item in the Playback History UI to remove it from the history.
